description: This file defines a singleton class 'AgentEventStore' that manages a collection of 'ControlAgentEvent' objects, providing methods to append new events while maintaining a maximum size, and a method to clear all events.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for storing and managing 'ControlAgentEvent' instances with thread-safe access.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new 'ControlAgentEvent' to the internal events list and ensures the list size does not exceed 'maxEvents'.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all events from the store.
